仙人掌怎样留住水？: How does a cactus save water?
给沙漠下一场雨，看看胖胖的茎怎样储水，再打开白天和夜晚的窗口。: Bring rain to the desert, watch the thick stem store water, and switch between day and night.
仙人掌也需要水。储水和省水，能帮助它度过干旱。: Cacti need water too. Storing it and limiting loss help them through drought.
多数沙漠仙人掌在较凉的夜晚开放气孔，吸收二氧化碳，也会损失一些水。: Most desert cacti open pores in the cooler night to take in carbon dioxide. Some water escapes too.
白天很热，许多沙漠仙人掌关闭气孔，减少失水。蜡质表层也能帮助留住水。: In hot daylight, many desert cacti close pores to reduce water loss. A waxy surface also helps.
雨水被根吸收，茎里的细胞储存了更多水，茎变得饱满。它不是装满清水的空瓶子。: Roots take up rainwater, stem cells store more water, and the stem fills out. It is not an empty bottle of clear water.
储水所剩不多，茎收缩了。仙人掌也不能永远不喝水，试试下一场雨。: Little stored water remains and the stem has shrunk. Cacti cannot go without water forever. Try rain.
干燥时间过去，储水逐渐减少，茎会收缩。刺、表皮和气孔的工作方式帮助它省水。: Dry weather uses up stored water and the stem contracts. Spines, skin and the way pores work help save water.
许多沙漠仙人掌以肉质茎的储水组织应对干旱，棱有助于随含水量伸缩；浅而广的根系可迅: Many desert cacti store water in succulent stem tissues; ribs accommodate changes in volume. Broad shallow roots can exploit brief rainfall. A thick cuticle reduces surface loss, and spines provide shade and modify airflow. Typical CAM plants open stomata mainly at night to fix carbon dioxide, using stored carbon for photosynthesis during the day.
储水格数不是升数，也不是存活天数。图中茎的伸缩、气孔和根被放大；白天关闭、夜晚开: The water indicator is neither liters nor survival days. Stem changes, stomata and roots are enlarged. Daytime closure and nighttime opening simplify a typical desert cactus; species and water stress alter the pattern. Water is held in tissue cells, not a pool of drinking water.
胖胖的部分是茎: The thick part is a stem
很多仙人掌把水储存在茎里的细胞中。下雨后更饱满，干旱时慢慢消耗储水。: Many cacti store water in cells inside their stems. Rain makes them fuller; drought gradually uses up stored water.
刺能挡住一些阳光、减弱贴近表面的风。观察仙人掌时用眼睛看，别用手摸。: Spines provide some shade and reduce airflow near the surface. Look closely with your eyes without touching.
